shelters.name: Nebraska Humane Society
shelters.description: Established 1875, fifth oldest Humane Society in the United States. Originally founded for protection of both animals and children. Provides adoption, medical care, and animal control services.

shelters.name: Capital Humane Society
shelters.description: Serves community by sheltering unwanted pets, advocates for animal welfare, and strives to educate the public about responsible pet care.

shelters.name: Hearts United for Animals
shelters.description: No-kill organization dedicated to relieving suffering of domestic animals by providing quality shelter, sanctuary, adoptions, and promoting animal welfare issues.

shelters.name: Central Nebraska Humane Society
shelters.description: Established 1967, open entry shelter caring for over 3,000 animals annually. In 2024: reunited 693 lost animals, adopted 741, transferred 122. Shelters 70 dogs and 125+ cats daily.

shelters.name: Animal Shelter of Northeast Nebraska
shelters.description: Since 2016, saved over 6,000 animals. Offers educational services for youth, supports domestic violence survivors, assists Veterans and seniors. Receives no city or state funding.

shelters.name: Kearney Area Animal Shelter
shelters.description: No-kill, nonprofit animal shelter dedicated to providing safe, loving environment for dogs and cats. Rescues, rehabilitates, and finds forever homes.

shelters.name: Panhandle Humane Society
shelters.description: Prevents neglect, abuse, and cruelty towards animals while addressing pet overpopulation and homelessness in the Nebraska Panhandle.

shelters.name: Homeward Bound in the Heartland
shelters.description: Small group of rescuers in Omaha area. Foster-based rescue that doesn't discriminate on health, age, or breed. Rescues animals from difficult situations.

shelters.name: McCook Humane Society
shelters.description: Providing a temporary home for dogs and cats since 1983. Serving southwest Nebraska.

shelters.name: Town and Country Animal Rescue
shelters.description: Animal rescue organization serving the Omaha metro and Papillion area with adoption services.

shelters.name: Paws-itive Partners
shelters.description: Animal rescue serving the North Platte and central Nebraska area.

shelters.name: Golden Retriever Rescue in Nebraska
shelters.description: Founded 1991, provides network to shelter, rehabilitate, and re-home Golden Retrievers displaced due to family circumstances or other needs.

shelters.name: Heartland Pet Connection
shelters.description: Animal rescue serving the Hastings and south central Nebraska area with adoption and foster services.

shelters.name: York Adopt-a-Pet
shelters.description: Animal rescue and adoption organization serving the York and eastern Nebraska area.

shelters.name: Bullies-N-Beyond ResQ
shelters.description: All-volunteer 501(c)(3) nonprofit providing safe adoptive homes for every dog in their care and advocating for Bully dog breeds through education.

notes: Comprehensive collection of Nebraska animal shelters, humane societies, and rescue organizations. Nebraska Humane Society (established 1875) is the fifth oldest humane society in the US. Central Nebraska Humane Society (since 1967) cares for 3,000+ animals annually. Coverage spans Omaha, Lincoln, Grand Island, Norfolk, Kearney, Scottsbluff, and rural communities.
